project.name: Memphis Rap Instrumental Dark Slow Build

arrangement.notes: Arrangement features a slow build from minimal instrumentation to a fuller sound with layered beats and textures typical of Memphis Rap style.

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: Introduce higher energy drum pattern for hook

event_markers.label: Outro Start
event_markers.reason: Energy drop for outro, strip down drums

track_roles.drums: Rhythmic backbone with sparse hi-hats and distinctive kick
track_roles.bass: Deep, moody bass supporting the slow build
track_roles.chords: Dark, mellow pads and stabs to add texture
track_roles.melody: Sparse melodic motifs enhancing tension during hooks
track_roles.fx: Atmospheric sound effects for transitions and mood

sensei_drum.brief: Create a rhythmic drum pattern with slow build intensity, emphasizing traditional Memphis Rap kick and hi-hat sounds.

bass_generator.brief: Generate a deep, moody bassline that slowly intensifies to support the dark mood and gradual energy increase.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop chord textures and pads that maintain a dark atmosphere and evolve gradually over the arrangement.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse melodic phrases primarily during the hook sections to enhance the slow build without overwhelming the instrumental.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee the overall arrangement to ensure a coherent slow build energy curve and dark mood compliance.

presetor.brief: Manage presets focusing on dark tones, vintage Memphis Rap instruments, and effects appropriate for slow build progression.

songgps.brief: Guide section transitions with clear markers and maintain energy flow across the 80 bars.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare the mix to retain clarity of slow build dynamics and emphasize the dark instrumental layers without vocals.
